title: Runtime options for {{service}}
description: Container options this service may set. Everything else, such as extra capabilities or devices, stays out of reach.

ulimits.label: Ulimits
ulimits.hint: One per line, name=soft:hard. Up to {{max}} of {{names}}.

extraHosts.label: Extra hosts
extraHosts.hint: One per line, hostname:ip. Up to {{max}}.

dns.label: DNS servers
dns.hint: One IP per line. Up to {{max}}.

init.label: Init process
init.hint: Run a minimal init as PID 1.

badUlimit: Use name=soft or name=soft:hard on each line.
readOnly: You need the sensitive write ability to change runtime options.
